articles.title: Nvidia Launches New Safety Platform to Keep AI Agents Under Control
articles.summary: American chip-maker Nvidia has introduced a new tool called the Open AI Agent Safety Platform, designed to help keep artificial intelligence systems safe and responsible. As AI 'agents' — computer programmes that can think and act on their own — become more common in workplaces and daily life, many experts worry about whether they can be trusted to make good decisions. Nvidia's new platform aims to give developers better ways to monitor and control what AI agents do. This is an important step in making sure AI technology helps people rather than causes harm, and comes as governments and tech companies around the world discuss how to set rules for AI.

lv1: What is the name of the new safety platform that Nvidia launched? (Nvidia推出的新安全平台叫什麼名字？)
What does an AI 'agent' do? (人工智能「代理」是做什麼的？)
lv2: Why do you think it is important to have a safety platform for AI agents? (你認為為人工智能代理設立安全平台為何重要？)
How might AI agents change the way people work or study in the future? (人工智能代理可能怎樣改變人們未來的工作或學習方式？)
lv3: Should technology companies be responsible for making their AI systems safe, or should governments create the rules? Discuss different perspectives. (科技公司應該負責確保其人工智能系統安全，還是應由政府制定規則？試討論不同觀點。)
Some people believe AI agents will make life better, while others worry they could take away jobs or cause harm. Who do you agree with and why? (有些人認為人工智能代理會讓生活更美好，另一些人則擔心它們可能令人失業或造成傷害。你認同哪種看法？為什麼？)

articles.title: Scientists Discover New Tick-Borne Virus in China Causing Flu-Like Illness
articles.summary: Researchers have identified a previously unknown virus in China that is spread by ticks — tiny creatures that cling to animals and humans. People infected with this virus may experience symptoms similar to the flu, including fever, tiredness, stomach troubles, and a lower-than-normal platelet count, which can affect how blood clots. Scientists believe the new virus may explain some mystery illness cases that doctors struggled to diagnose in the past. Ticks are commonly found in forests and grassy outdoor areas. Experts are now working to understand how widely the virus has spread and are looking at ways to help protect people from becoming infected.

lv1: What kind of creature carries the new virus discovered in China? (在中國發現的新病毒由什麼生物傳播？)
Name one symptom a person might have if they catch this virus. (說出一種感染此病毒後可能出現的症狀。)
lv2: Why is it important for scientists to identify new viruses quickly? (為什麼科學家需要快速識別新病毒？)
How can people protect themselves when spending time outdoors in areas where ticks might live? (人們在可能有蜱蟲的戶外地區活動時，應如何保護自己？)
lv3: When a new virus is discovered, who should decide how to respond — scientists, governments, or the public? Why might these groups have different priorities? (發現新病毒時，誰應決定如何應對——科學家、政府還是公眾？這些群體為何可能有不同的優先考量？)

Some people avoid outdoor activities like hiking out of fear of diseases, while others say the health benefits outweigh the risks. What is your view, and how should society balance these concerns? (有些人因害怕疾病而避免遠足等戶外活動，另一些人則認為健康益處大於風險。你的看法是什麼？社會應如何平衡這些顧慮？)

articles.title: 曼谷暴雨成災　洪水肆虐多區　當局宣布全市進入洪災狀態
articles.summary: 泰國首都曼谷上週四起連續多天遭受大暴雨侵襲，部分地區在48小時內錄得約300毫米雨量，引發嚴重水浸。當局即時宣布全市進入洪災狀態，救援人員緊急協助居民疏散。道路被洪水淹沒，交通大混亂，不少市民家園受損。今次洪災再次令人關注氣候變化對城市的威脅，以及城市排水系統能否應對日益頻繁的極端天氣事件。

lv1: 這次嚴重洪災發生在哪個國家的首都？
曼谷當局在洪災中宣布了什麼措施？
lv2: 為什麼城市在暴雨後容易出現嚴重水浸？排水系統扮演什麼角色？
氣候變化怎樣令極端天氣事件變得更頻繁和嚴重？
lv3: 政府和市民在應對洪災方面各有什麼責任？誰應該承擔更大的角色？
面對氣候變化帶來的極端天氣，城市應如何在發展建設與防災減災之間取得平衡？

articles.title: 中國最北高鐵哈伊高鐵正式通車　穿越高寒地帶創歷史
articles.summary: 中國最北端的高速鐵路——哈爾濱至伊春高鐵（哈伊高鐵）近日正式投入運營，全程僅需約1小時46分鐘，大幅縮短兩地出行時間。這是中國首條穿越高寒島狀凍土地帶的高鐵線路，工程師需克服嚴寒氣候與複雜地質等重重難關。高鐵通車不但方便沿線居民日常出行，更有助促進當地旅遊業及整體經濟發展，體現中國高鐵技術的持續突破與進步。

lv1: 哈伊高鐵連接哪兩個城市？
乘搭哈伊高鐵全程大約需要多少時間？
lv2: 在高寒地區建造高鐵面對哪些特別挑戰？工程師需要解決什麼問題？
高鐵通車怎樣幫助沿線地區的居民和推動經濟發展？
lv3: 中國大力發展高鐵網絡，有人認為有助減少碳排放，亦有人擔心大型基建工程破壞自然環境。你認為應如何取捨？
高速鐵路與航空及公路運輸相比，各有什麼優勢和缺點？你認為未來的交通應以哪種方式為主？
